test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: Sawai Jai Singh, the ruler of Amber, is known to have constructed five astronomical observatories called ‘Jantar Mantar’. Which of the following cities does NOT have any of these observatories?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Udaipur.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The wealthy **Gujarat and Malwa provinces' subadari **were grabbed by powerful Rajput households. Sawai Raja Jai Singh of Amber served as governor of Malwa, while Raja Ajit Singh of **Jodhpur presided over Gujarat.**
 
• In 1722, **Sawai Jai Singh received the subadari** of Agra and established Jaipur as his new capital. **Five astronomical observatorie**s were built by Sawai Jai Singh, the monarch of Amber, one each in **Delhi, Jaipur, Ujjain, Mathura, and Varanasi.** These observatories, also known as **Jantar Mantar, **possessed a number of tools for studying celestial bodies.
 
• The** Rajput monarch Sawai Jai Singh II, **who founded Jaipur, Rajasthan, commissioned the construction of 19 astronomical instruments that make up the Jantar Mantar in Jaipur. In 1734, the** monument was finished.**
 
• **One of the five observatories** Maharaja Jai Singh II of Jaipur established in **1724 is Jantar Mantar** in New Delhi.
 
• This time observatory was constructed after** Maharaja Jai Singh II **was given the assignment by Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah to review the **astronomical and calendar records.**
 
• In the** second half of the eighteenth century**, Sawai Jai Singh II, Maharaja of Amber and Jaipur, built five observatories in the northern Indian cities of **Shahjahanabad (Delhi), Jaipur, Ujjain, Mathura, and Varanasi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **amazing ruler of Jaipur, Sawai Jai Singh II,** was a master of mathematics, astronomy, and urban planning.
 
• He established the **city of Jaipur and the renowned observatories** known as Jantar Mantar. Amber was ruled by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II (1686–1743), a **Rajput in India.**
 
• **Maharaja Jai Singh of Jaipur **constructed the **Jantar Mantar in **New Delhi, India, and Asia using red-colored instruments.
